title: neoalsomitra angustipetala
intro: Neoalsomitra angustipetala, commonly known as the Narrow-petaled Alsomitra, is a plant species in the family Cucurbitaceae, native to Indonesia. The health benefits of Neoalsomitra angustipetala include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Neoalsomitra angustipetala include cucurbitacins, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
